channel.title: Swiss Data Events: upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland
channel.description: Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a curated list of upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed every day. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.

item.title: Davos Super Intelligence Summit 2027 (19 Jan 2027, Davos)
item.description: 19 Jan 2027, 16:00–20:00 · Grandhotel Belvedere, Promenade 89, Davos · Conference · Not listed (access by invitation; invitations can be requested). Afternoon summit during WEF week with four keynote-led panels on AGI and agentic AI, physical AI and robotics, AI infrastructure, and social impact through innovation; attendance is by invitation, which can be requested on the site. Organiser: Davos Premier.

item.title: 50. MEET SWISS INFOSEC! — Künstliche Intelligenz zwischen Security, Privacy und Ethik (25 Jan 2027, Zurich-Flughafen)
item.description: 25 Jan 2027, 13:15–17:15 (doors 12:30, apéro afterwards) · Radisson Blu Hotel Zürich Airport, Zurich-Flughafen · Conference · Free (registration required, 300 places). Half-day afternoon conference on what AI can, may and should do, with Swiss AI regulation, a session on data governance and running Microsoft Copilot securely, new cyber risks in companies, and a closing ethics keynote by Prof. Peter G. Kirchschläger. Organiser: Swiss Infosec AG.

item.title: Winterkongress 2027 (5 Mar 2027 – 6 Mar 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 5 Mar 2027 – 6 Mar 2027 · Rote Fabrik, Seestrasse 395, Zurich · Conference · CHF 45 (reduced CHF 30). Two-day non-commercial congress of the Digitale Gesellschaft with four tracks — digital self-defence, ethics and society, law and politics, and networks, security, hard- and software — covering data protection and AI policy; presale opens in mid-December. Organiser: Digitale Gesellschaft with Rote Fabrik.

item.title: Education is Broken. Now What? (2 Dec 2026, Schlieren (Zurich))
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 09:00–17:30 · DARE Campus, Schlieren, Schlieren (Zurich) · Workshop · Free (general registration full; reserved places by application). Day-long co-creation workshop where students, teachers, parents and tech practitioners work out what learning should look like alongside AI, data science, UX and open-source tooling; an official side event on the road to the Geneva AI Summit 2027. Organiser: Systematic-X with CH Open, Women in AI & Robotics, Women in Data Science and the Wikimedia Foundation.

item.title: Switech — Founders and Innovators, Geneva Edition (2 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 18:30–22:00 · Les Halles de l’Île (address on registration), Geneva · Networking · From CHF 8 (name your own price; free early-bird tickets gone). Evening for Geneva founders and builders with an introduction to EPFL AI and a talk on how to build with AI without being an engineer, followed by curated introductions and networking. Organiser: Switech.

item.title: December C++ Meetup — Are We Ready for Agentic Coding Interviews? (10 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 18:30–21:00 · Google Zurich, Europaallee 36, Zurich · Meetup · Free. Zürich C++ community evening at Google Europaallee, with Pavel Filonov asking whether technical interview formats still make sense now that candidates code alongside AI agents, plus snacks and socialising. Organiser: Zürich C++ Meetup.

item.title: Davos AI Summit 2027 — The Science of New Worlds (20 Jan 2027, Davos)
item.description: 20 Jan 2027, 08:30–17:30 · The Dome, Davos · Conference · Not listed (RSVP required). Tenth edition of Imagination in Action’s Davos AI Summit, running alongside the World Economic Forum, with sessions on frontier intelligence, human and machine agency and the foundations of progress. Organiser: Imagination in Action, in collaboration with MIT CSAIL and Stanford HAI.

item.title: Insomni'hack 2027 (1 Feb 2027 – 5 Feb 2027, Ecublens (Lausanne))
item.description: 1 Feb 2027 – 5 Feb 2027 · SwissTech Convention Center, Route Louis-Favre 2, Ecublens (Lausanne) · Conference · Paid (ticket tiers on insomnihack.ch). Switzerland’s largest security conference on the EPFL campus: three days of hands-on workshops from 1 to 3 February, then two conference days of talks on 4 and 5 February plus the overnight capture-the-flag contest. Organiser: Orange Cyberdefense Switzerland.

item.title: Journée IA & Enseignement #2 (16 Feb 2027, Nationwide)
item.description: 16 Feb 2027 · HEIA-FR Fribourg, Amphimax UNIL Lausanne, UNINE Neuchâtel and Campus Biotech UNIGE Geneva, plus online, Nationwide · Conference · Free (limited places; ticketing opens mid-December 2026). Second edition of the Swiss higher-education day on AI and teaching, running simultaneously on four university campuses with talks broadcast between the sites and online; an official pre-event on the road to the Geneva AI Summit. Organiser: HES-SO, UNIFR, UNIGE, UNIL, UNINE and swissuniversities.

item.title: Rencontre avec Anne Hiltpold — IA & éducation : former aujourd’hui les compétences de demain (10 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 12:00–14:00 (reception from 11:30) · CCIG, Boulevard du Théâtre 4, Geneva · Conference · CHF 45 (CCIG members) / CHF 70. Lunch meeting at the Geneva chamber of commerce where Anne Hiltpold, president of the Geneva Council of State, presents survey results on how Geneva students already use AI, followed by a discussion with businesses on what it changes for skills, jobs and training. Organiser: CCIG — Chambre de commerce, d’industrie et des services de Genève.

item.title: Philanthropy Lunch — AI, Governance and Philanthropy (10 Dec 2026, Geneva)
item.description: 10 Dec 2026, 12:00–14:00 · Uni Dufour, Salle 408, Rue du Général-Dufour 24, Geneva · Conference · Not listed (registration required). Hybrid lunch session on the part philanthropy can play in coordinating good AI governance across international Geneva, with speakers from the University of Geneva and the Geneva AI Governance Institute. Organiser: Geneva Centre for Philanthropy, University of Geneva, with GAIGI — Geneva AI Governance Institute.

item.title: Swiss Cyber Security Days 2027 — When AI Acts (23 Feb 2027 – 24 Feb 2027, Bern)
item.description: 23 Feb 2027 – 24 Feb 2027 · BernExpo, Mingerstrasse 6, Bern · Conference · Not announced. Two-day conference and exhibition built around AI shifting from a supporting tool to an autonomous actor, with keynotes and panels on the resulting questions of trust, accountability and digital sovereignty. Organiser: BERNEXPO AG.

item.title: Technology Briefing: Accelerating Innovation Processes with AI (1 Dec 2026, Dübendorf)
item.description: 1 Dec 2026, 14:00–17:45 · Empa Akademie, Überlandstrasse 129, Dübendorf · Conference · Free (all tickets taken; waiting list on the event page). Afternoon briefing in English where researchers from Empa, CSEM and PSI and industry experts from ABB and Sulzer show how AI and automation are reshaping R&D — lab-to-fab translation, high-throughput thin-film materials discovery, innovation in expert-driven industries and low-carbon cement design — closing with an apéro. Organiser: Empa Akademie, with CSEM and PSI.

item.title: Forgis Research Night — December 2026 (2 Dec 2026, Schlieren (Zurich))
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 19:00–22:00 · DARE Campus, Zürcherstrasse 39D, Schlieren (Zurich) · Meetup · Free (registration subject to host approval). Monthly physical-AI evening at Forgis’ headquarters: two lightning talks with Q&A — Shifeng Xie on structured-data foundation models and Forgis CTO Riccardo Maggioni on synthetic data — then an open floor with rooftop drinks. item.title: Global Innovation Week 2027 (18 Jan 2027 – 22 Jan 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 18 Jan 2027 – 22 Jan 2027 · Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport Convention Center, The Circle 41 (18 Jan) and University of Zurich (22 Jan), Zurich · Conference · Not announced (single sessions or full days; ticket sales opening soon). Independently organised programme in Zurich during WEF week: a Monday on AI-ready data centres with René Raeber (Microsoft Switzerland) and Stefan Berg (Swisscom) plus roundtables on power and storage, connectivity and cooling, and defending against AI-driven attacks; a Thursday on technology and the future of capital; and a Friday dialogue on AI and trust. Organiser: hoi — House of Innovation Switzerland.

item.title: Lunch & Learn: Täuschend echt — Deepfakes im Alltag erkennen und einordnen (18 Jan 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 18 Jan 2027, 12:00–13:00 · Online · Webinar · Not listed (registration required). Lunchtime session with AI consultant Vero Sallenbach on how deepfakes are made, why no single visual or audio tell is reliable, and a step-by-step check for source, context and cross-referencing, with a short checklist to take away. Organiser: AI4ALL Switzerland.

item.title: #TechDemo x skilder — l’agentisation des compétences (26 Jan 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 26 Jan 2027, 12:30–13:00 · Online · Webinar · Free (registration required). Half-hour live stream on Alp ICT’s channel with Nicolas Corod, founder of the Swiss start-up skilder, on turning business know-how into skills that AI assistants and agents can actually use, and how to share and govern them across an organisation. Organiser: Alp ICT.

item.title: AI Village 2027 (27 Jan 2027, Fribourg)
item.description: 27 Jan 2027, from 08:30 · HEIA-FR, Boulevard de Pérolles 80, Fribourg · Conference · CHF 100 early bird, CHF 50 student. Day-long Swiss Cyber Storm spin-off bringing AI practitioners, students and security professionals together for hands-on workshops, talks, demos and a CTF challenge on where AI and cybersecurity meet. Organiser: AI Village, a spin-off of the Swiss Cyber Storm Association.

item.title: KI-Stammtisch Rheintal #1 — Generative KI (15 Feb 2027, Widnau (St. Gallen))
item.description: 15 Feb 2027, 16:30–18:30 · Nowo Coworking Space, Bahnhofstrasse 14, Widnau (St. Gallen) · Meetup · Not listed (registration requested). First of a new after-work round table for the Rheintal SME AI community — no stage talks, just participants swapping what generative AI really does in their day-to-day work, what does not work, and what they plan to try next. Organiser: thinking services ag, in partnership with swissAI.

item.title: KI-Stammtisch Rheintal #2 — Agentische KI (1 Mar 2027, Widnau (St. Gallen))
item.description: 1 Mar 2027, 16:30–18:30 · Nowo Coworking Space, Bahnhofstrasse 14, Widnau (St. Gallen) · Meetup · Not listed (registration requested). Second Rheintal KI-Stammtisch, this time on AI agents: what they can already take over in a small or mid-sized company, which questions are still open, and what the people in the room have tried themselves. Organiser: thinking services ag, in partnership with swissAI.

item.title: DigiDay Bern 2027 — Digitale Souveränität (15 Mar 2027, Bern)
item.description: 15 Mar 2027, 10:00–18:00 · Kursaal Bern, Kornhausstrasse 3, Bern · Conference · Free (registration by 14 February 2027). Day on digital sovereignty for the Swiss–Austrian e-government community, covering the government cloud, e-ID, cybersecurity, data governance and how AI is regulated and used across public administration and industry. Organiser: ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA Zürich, in cooperation with the Austrian Embassy in Bern.

item.title: swissICT Webinar: KI & Digital Transformation — Planung, Umsetzung, Steuerung und Wirkungsmessung (1 Dec 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00–16:30 · Online · Webinar · Free. Reiner Petzold on steering AI and digital transformation programmes through KPI- and OKR-based dashboards, and why the human side — culture, roles and decision logic — decides whether the strategy delivers anything. Organiser: swissICT Fachgruppe Digital Transformation Insight.

item.title: Webinar: KI-gestütztes Buchschreiben — die Architektur hinter «Outevolve» (2 Dec 2026, Online (CH))
item.description: 2 Dec 2026, 16:00–17:00 · Online · Webinar · Free. Peter Beck and Andreas Schliep take their AI agent stack apart layer by layer — Obsidian as the knowledge hub, Claude Code as the engine, 50-plus skills and MCP integrations — the same production setup that wrote every line of their book, including where it falls short. Organiser: DasScrumTeam AG, Zug.

item.title: Brain2Brain Labs: BASE, une heure pour façonner votre IA (3 Dec 2026, Neuchâtel)
item.description: 3 Dec 2026, 18:00–21:00 · Microcity, Rue de la Pierre-à-Mazel 39, 3rd floor, Neuchâtel · Workshop · Free for members / CHF 35 guests. Live demonstration of BASE 2.0, AI Swiss's open standard for teaching an AI tool a team's own knowledge, working methods and rules: an hour of team discussion is transcribed, turned into instructions, sources and rules, then tested on real cases — in French, no technical background needed. Organiser: AI Swiss.

item.title: What if AI belonged to all of us? (14 Dec 2026, Zurich)
item.description: 14 Dec 2026, 19:00–22:00 · Kraftwerk, Selnaustrasse 25, Zurich · Meetup · CHF 10. Evening at Kraftwerk on whether AI should be a public good: an opening talk arguing that AI alignment cannot be top-down, a fireside chat and public deliberation on how Switzerland should build and govern its own AI, then interactive roundtables — aimed at a general audience, no technical background needed. Organiser: Swiss {ai} Weeks with Kickstart Innovation and Impact Hub.

item.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Strategie in 20 Minuten — vom Prinzip zur Priorisierung (12 Jan 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 12 Jan 2027, 16:30–17:00 · Online · Webinar · Free. Prof. Bramwell Kaltenrieder of BFH compares six proven approaches to AI strategy and hands over a Swiss-focused standard process, from AI ambition through use-case prioritisation to scaling, with the EU AI Act in the background. Organiser: swissICT Fachgruppe Digital Transformation Insight.

item.title: Computational Life Sciences Day 2027 — AI Agents and Real Life (13 Jan 2027, Wädenswil (Zurich))
item.description: 13 Jan 2027, 12:00–17:00 · ZHAW Campus Grüental, Building GA, Grüentalstrasse 14, Wädenswil (Zurich) · Conference · CHF 50. Afternoon conference on autonomous AI agents moving from demo to production across biotechnology, healthcare, agriculture, food and environmental science, with company keynotes, ICLS research spotlights, a podium discussion and a networking apéro; registration closes 15 December 2026. Organiser: ZHAW Institute of Computational Life Sciences (ICLS).

item.title: Agile Breakfast Luzern — Die agentische Organisation ist bereits Realität (15 Jan 2027, Lucerne)
item.description: 15 Jan 2027, 08:30–10:30 · Lucerne · Meetup · Free. Filipe Inacio of Break shows fully agentic development setups already running in Swiss companies, followed by a moderated group discussion on what is left to coach, organise and orchestrate when the agent is a team member. Organiser: Agile Breakfast Luzern (swissICT).

item.title: Rethinking Cardinality & Secrets to Reliable Software (21 Jan 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 21 Jan 2027, 17:30–20:30 · Digicomp Academy AG, Limmatstrasse 50, Zurich · Meetup · Not listed. Joel Verezhak of Grafana Labs argues that fear of high-cardinality metrics is a historical habit rather than a hard limit, and shows what Parquet engines, ClickHouse and OTLP pipelines change; Dorota Parad follows on the foundations of reliable software that have nothing to do with your tech stack. Organiser: DevOps Meetup Zürich.

item.title: Was KI morgen kann und heute darf — interaktiver KI & Compliance Event (27 Jan 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 27 Jan 2027, 07:30–11:00 (programme from 08:15) · Kinokoni, Lagerstrasse 104, Europaallee, Zurich · Meetup · Free. Morning session on using AI to capture the know-how walking out of the door with retiring staff: Prof. Andreas Lorenz (FHNW) on what AI can do for knowledge capture today, and lawyer Markus Näf on which business data may go into which kind of AI under data protection, governance and compliance rules. Organiser: iSource AG.

item.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Strategie in 20 Minuten — vom Prinzip zur Priorisierung (Januar-Wiederholung) (27 Jan 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 27 Jan 2027, 16:30–17:00 · Online · Webinar · Free. Repeat of the 20-minute AI strategy session with Prof. Bramwell Kaltenrieder of BFH: six proven approaches compared and a Swiss-focused standard process from AI ambition to use-case prioritisation and scaling. Organiser: swissICT Fachgruppe Digital Transformation Insight.

item.title: 12. F&E-Konferenz — Digitalisation, Automation and AI in Industry (28 Jan 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 28 Jan 2027, 12:00–18:00 · ETH Zürich, Campus Hönggerberg, HPH building, Zurich · Conference · CHF 180 members / CHF 250 non-members / CHF 60 students (excl. VAT). Swiss industry research-and-development conference on digitalisation, automation and artificial intelligence, run as rapid five-minute pitches across three parallel sessions on intelligent connected products, manufacturing processes and resilient value creation. Organiser: Swissmem with SATW and Swiss Engineering, in collaboration with Innosuisse.

item.title: swissICT Webinar: KI-Tools für mehr Effizienz — welche passen zu meinem Unternehmen? (9 Feb 2027, Online (CH))
item.description: 9 Feb 2027, 16:00–16:30 · Online · Webinar · Free. Moritz Maier of BFH gives practical criteria for picking between ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude and the long tail of niche tools, sorted by use case, data-protection requirements and team size. Organiser: swissICT Fachgruppe Digital Transformation Insight.

item.title: Composable Kubernetes Operators & Intent-Based Infrastructure (17 Feb 2027, Zurich)
item.description: 17 Feb 2027, 17:30–20:30 · Digicomp Academy AG, Limmatstrasse 50, Zurich · Meetup · Not listed. Tristan Smagghe of Infomaniak on designing composable Kubernetes operators that coordinate through contracts behind Infomaniak’s new hosting platform, then Torsten Boettjer on an open-source intent layer that lets operators and AI agents describe desired state and drive autonomous operations. Organiser: DevOps Meetup Zürich.

item.description: 14 Dec 2026 – 16 Dec 2026 · CERN, Salle Marie Skłodowska-Curie (40/S2-C01), Meyrin (Geneva) · Workshop · Not listed (application required).
